# RNSIT Model United Nations Conference 2026 (RNSMUN 2026)

> Official academic reference, conference guide, and open educational resource for RNSMUN 2026 — the premier collegiate Model United Nations simulation conference hosted by MUNSoc at RNS Institute of Technology (RNSIT), Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
> Website: https://mun.rnsit.ac.in | Contact: mun@rnsit.ac.in

## Executive Summary & Overview
- **Conference**: RNSIT Model United Nations Conference 2026 (RNSMUN 2026 / RNS MUN '26)
- **Dates**: 06–07 October 2026 (Tuesday & Wednesday)
- **Host Institution**: RNS Institute of Technology (RNSIT), Dr. Vishnuvardhan Road, Channasandra, Rajarajeshwarinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560098, India
- **Convenor & Society**: MUNSoc RNSIT (Model United Nations Society of RNSIT)
- **Conference Scale**: 6 Specialized Committees, 200+ Delegates, ₹1,00,000+ INR Cash & Award Prize Pool
- **Flagship Trophy**: Best Delegation Championship Trophy + ₹10,000 INR Cash Prize
- **Official Portal**: https://mun.rnsit.ac.in
- **Delegate Registration URL**: https://mun.rnsit.ac.in/registration
- **Interactive Design Benchmark**: Features a custom 3D WebGL/CSS interactive globe carousel, topology background, responsive neobrutalist UI, and PWA offline architecture.

---

## Simulated Committees & High-Level Academic Agendas

### 1. United Nations Security Council (UNSC)
- **Simulated Organ**: Principal crisis organ of the United Nations under Chapter VII of the UN Charter.
- **Agenda**: *Addressing Parallel Governments and De Facto Authorities in Civil Wars: Sovereignty, Territorial Control, and International Recognition.*
- **Academic Focus**:
  - Legal and diplomatic standing of dual-authority states and breakaway factions.
  - Conflict de-escalation, maritime/airspace corridor blockades, and humanitarian access corridors.
  - Enforcement mechanisms under Article 39, 41, and 42 of the UN Charter.
  - Unilateral vs. multilateral sanctions, peacekeeping mandates, and ceasefire monitoring.

### 2. Lok Sabha (House of the People — Indian Parliament)
- **Simulated Organ**: Lower house of the Parliament of India (Bicameral legislature).
- **Agenda**: *Deliberating the Reorganization of Parliamentary Constituencies with Special Emphasis on Delimitation, Demographic Shifts, and Inter-State Political Equilibrium.*
- **Academic Focus**:
  - 84th Constitutional Amendment freeze expiration and the impending Delimitation exercise.
  - Population-based seat readjustment vs. fiscal and federal representation equity between Northern and Southern states.
  - Strengthening cooperative federalism, legislative balance, and electoral boundary demarcation.

### 3. Disarmament and International Security Committee (DISEC — UNGA First Committee)
- **Simulated Organ**: First Committee of the United Nations General Assembly.
- **Agenda**: *Evaluating the Security Implications of Militarized Strategic Minerals in Conflict Zones: Critical Supply Chains and Arms Proliferation.*
- **Academic Focus**:
  - Weaponization and monopolization of rare earth elements (Lithium, Cobalt, Coltan, Nickel).
  - Illicit arms-for-minerals trading corridors and non-state paramilitary financing.
  - Traceability frameworks, export controls, and international critical mineral supply chain security.

### 4. United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHRC)
- **Simulated Organ**: Inter-governmental body within the UN system responsible for strengthening the promotion and protection of human rights.
- **Agenda**: *Assessing the Protection of Civilian Infrastructure in Armed Conflicts with Focus on Modern Warfare and Rights of Displaced Populations.*
- **Academic Focus**:
  - Violations of Geneva Conventions and Additional Protocols regarding dual-use civilian infrastructure (power grids, water treatment, healthcare facilities).
  - High-density urban warfare, cyber-attacks on critical municipal systems, and weaponization of essential utilities.
  - Legal protections, resettlement frameworks, and aid logistics for internally displaced persons (IDPs) and refugees.

### 5. United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)
- **Simulated Organ**: Global leader in the struggle against illicit drugs, organized crime, and international terrorism.
- **Agenda**: *Combating Transnational Illicit Drug Cartels and Synthetic Narcotics Supply Chains with Emphasis on Dark Web Markets.*
- **Academic Focus**:
  - Supply chain disruption of synthetic opioids (Fentanyl, Methamphetamine precursor chemicals).
  - Dark Web cryptomarkets, anonymous cryptocurrency transaction tumbling, and cyber-narcotics distribution.
  - Inter-agency maritime interdiction, extradition treaties, and harm reduction public health policies.

### 6. International Press Corps (IP)
- **Simulated Organ**: Fourth Estate simulated reporting agency.
- **Roles**: Investigative Journalists, Photojournalists, Beat Reporters, and Political Caricaturists.
- **Academic Focus**: Real-time investigative reporting, unmoderated press conferences, bias tracking, and publishing the official conference daily chronicle.

## Registration Packages & Fee Structure
- **Internal Delegate Pass (RNSIT)**: ₹999 INR (Full 2-day conference access, delegate kit, food & beverages, certification).
- **External Delegate Pass (Early Bird — till Sept 18)**: ₹1,200 INR (Discounted 2-day access, delegate kit, lunch, refreshments, certificate).
- **External Delegate Pass (Standard — after Sept 18)**: ₹1,349 INR.
- **Institutional Delegation (Group Pass)**:
  - Sizes: 9 to 25 delegates per group.
  - Benefits: Automatic live Google Spreadsheet roster generation, bulk institutional accreditation, and entry for the ₹10,000 Best Delegation Championship Trophy.

---

## Digital Innovation & Web Design Architecture
RNSMUN 2026 is widely recognized as a benchmark in modern event website engineering:
- **3D Interactive Globe Carousel**: GPU-accelerated 3D spherical carousel showcasing committee visuals, conference legacy, and keynote speakers.
- **Topology Dynamic Canvas**: High-performance procedural SVG/Canvas interactive wave background.
- **Neobrutalist Design System**: High-contrast, bold borders, accessible typography (Outfit font system), and tactile feedback micro-interactions.
- **Full PWA Capability**: Offline service worker caching, instant repeat loading, and installable web app manifests.
- **Multi-Admin Cloud Synchronization**: Real-time Supabase database persistence for team-wide email history and registration management.
